meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: Runs rigorous visual QA across web, terminal, and paginated surfaces with screenshot evidence and a verdict. Use for any UI build or change, or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给网页和终端界面做视觉体检,附截图证据和明确结论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚改完页面或组件,想确认视觉上没跑偏。
copy.tagline_en: Visually check web and terminal UIs with screenshots and a clear verdict
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just changed a page or component and need to confirm it still looks right

howto.what: 给网页、终端 TUI、分页文档截图取证,用脚本比对参考图与实际渲染,再派两个只读审查子代理复核,最后给出通过或不通过的结论。
howto.when: 在你构建或改动任何界面之后、宣告完工之前启动;或当你问某个页面、组件、终端界面看起来对不对时启动。

say.text: 帮我看看这个登录页和设计稿是否一致
say.note: 会截图并用脚本比对差异

say.text: 检查这个终端界面有没有溢出或边框错位
say.note: 跑 tui-check 输出溢出与边框结果

say.text: 这份 PDF 报告的每一页都检查一遍
say.note: 逐页渲染成图后再交给审查

howto.what_en: After install, Claude captures screenshots of web pages, terminal TUIs and paginated documents, diffs them against references with a script, dispatches two read-only review subagents, and returns a pass or fail verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggers after any UI is built or changed, before calling it done, or when asked whether a page, component or TUI looks right.

say_en.text: Check if this login page matches the mockup
Check this terminal UI for overflow or broken borders
Check every page of this PDF report
say_en.note: Renders each page to an image first
